==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields plus as many of the optional fields as necessary and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{SWGTCG|set=|text=|cardname=|swglink=|scenario=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|set}} Name of the set or collection, such as ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]''.
*{{Para|cardname}} In order to specify which card is being cited and to link to an image on the ''Galaxies'' wiki, use {{Para|cardname}} '''without''' the (card) or .JPG portion of the file name on the wiki.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|sformatted}} Formatted name of the set or collection.
*{{Para|swglink}} If the file name differs from the cardname, use {{Para|swglink}} '''with''' the full file name and extension.
*{{Para|scenario}} If citing a scenario instead of a card.

===Backup links===
To add a backup link, archive the '''redirect link''' generated by the template. For the Identity Theft card, for example, one would enter <code><nowiki>https://swg.fandom.com/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/Identity_Theft_(card).JPG</nowiki></code> into the [https://web.archive.org/save Wayback Machine] and then use the resulting archivedate on [[Module:ArchiveAccess/SWGTCG]], following the examples there already. Note that the Wayback Machine will say that it has archived the resulting image link; the archivedate it gives is still the correct one even though the redirect link is what the Module will list.

==Example(s)==
<nowiki>{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Identity Theft}}</nowiki>

Results in:

{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Identity Theft}}

<hr />
;Using scenario
<nowiki>{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Festival of Love promotional scenario}}</nowiki>

Results in:
{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Festival of Love promotional scenario}}

<hr />
;Using swglink
<nowiki>{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Yoda Soup Bowl Replica|swglink=Yoda_soupbowl.png}}</nowiki>

Results in:

{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Yoda Soup Bowl Replica|swglink=Yoda soupbowl.png}}
